info.title: Airline Management API
info.description: Migrated endpoint from the legacy VB.NET BookFlightForm. Creates a booking for a flight with passenger details and an optional seat number.

post.description:
Creates a booking for the given flight. Ports legacy `BookFlightForm.BtnBook_Click` and `BookingService.CreateBooking`.

Validation rules (from legacy):
- `passengerName` is required, 2 to 255 characters, letters/spaces/hyphens/apostrophes only.
- `passengerEmail` is required, valid email format, max 255 characters.
- `seatNumber` is optional, max 10 characters, format `^[0-9]{1,3}[A-Z]{1,2}$` (case-insensitive). Stored in uppercase.

The operation runs in a database transaction: the flight row is locked, seat availability is re-checked, the booking is inserted, and the flight's available seats are decremented. If any step fails, the transaction is rolled back.

Authentication is optional. When a valid Bearer token is supplied, the booking is linked to that user (legacy `SessionManager.CurrentUser.Id`). Otherwise `userId` is stored as null.

parameters.name: flightId
parameters.description: ID of the flight to book (legacy `flightId` field set by the form constructor).

parameters.name: Authorization
parameters.description: Optional bearer token identifying the logged-in user. Replaces `SessionManager.IsAuthenticated()` / `SessionManager.CurrentUser`. If omitted, the booking is stored with a null user ID.

requestBody.description: Passenger details for the booking. Mirrors the legacy text boxes `txtPassengerName`, `txtPassengerEmail`, and `txtSeatNumber` (each trimmed before validation).

passengerName.description: Passenger full name. Letters, spaces, hyphens, and apostrophes only.

seatNumber.description: Optional seat number such as `12A` or `123AB`. Stored in uppercase. Omit or send an empty string for no seat assignment.

400.description: Validation failure. Legacy error messages are returned joined by a single space.

example.error: Passenger name must be between 2 and 255 characters. Invalid email format.

401.description: Not used by the legacy logic. Bookings are allowed without authentication. Returned only if a supplied Bearer token is malformed or expired.

409.description: No seats remaining on the flight (legacy: 'No available seats on this flight.').

example.error: No available seats on this flight.

500.description: Unexpected database or transaction error (legacy: 'An error occurred while creating the booking: ...').

example.error: An error occurred while creating the booking: database unavailable

bearerAuth.description: Optional. Identifies the logged-in user for the booking.
